# Feature request

## Problem

Describe the concrete workflow or failure mode. Explain why existing behavior is insufficient without claiming unmeasured users, benchmarks, or compatibility.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior, its inputs and outputs, expected exit/status semantics, and how it fits the existing contract.

## Alternatives

List alternatives considered, including existing tools or a smaller documentation-only change.

## Additional context

Include Python/Node and OS versions, package version or commit, a minimal sanitized example, and any evidence or coverage boundaries. Do not include credentials or private data.
